info.name: Baserow API spec Applications API
info.description:

For more information about our deprecation policy, please visit this page.

header.description: An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular client session. Then using the undo/redo endpoints with the same ClientSessionId header this action can be undone/redone.

An optional header that marks the action performed by this request as having occurred in a particular action group.Then calling the undo/redo endpoint with the same ClientSessionId header, all the actions belonging to the same action group can be undone/redone together in a single API call.

variable.description: (Required) The id of the application to duplicate.

request.description: Duplicate an application if the authorized user is in the application's workspace. All the related children are also going to be duplicated. For example in case of a database application all the underlying tables, fields, views and rows are going to be duplicated.

variable.description: (Required) Updates the order of the applications in the workspace related to the provided value.

request.description: Changes the order of the provided application ids to the matching position that the id has in the list. If the authorized user does not belong to the workspace it will be ignored. The order of the not provided tables will be set to `0`.

variable.description: (Required) Returns only applications that are in the workspace related to the provided value.

request.description: Lists all the applications of the workspace related to the provided `workspace_id` parameter if the authorized user is in that workspace. If theworkspace is related to a template, then this endpoint will be publicly accessible. The properties that belong to the application can differ per type. An application always belongs to a single workspace.

variable.description: (Required) Creates an application for the workspace related to the provided value.

request.description: Creates a new application based on the provided type. The newly created application is going to be added to the workspace related to the provided `workspace_id` parameter. If the authorized user does not belong to the workspace an error will be returned.
